## EventSpawnEntry

EventSpawnEntry associates an event from db/events.xml with mission-defined
positions and optional settings for infected spawned around those positions.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 3 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### EventSpawnEntry.name

Key: `name`

Path: [`event`](#eventspawnsfileevent).`[]`.`name`

Name matches the event identifier in db/events.xml.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |

### EventSpawnEntry.pos

Key: `pos`

Path: [`event`](#eventspawnsfileevent).`[]`.`pos`

Pos lists positions where this event may spawn. A position may reference a
reusable object group from cfgeventgroups.xml.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items reference | [`EventSpawnPos`](#eventspawnpos) (`#/$defs/EventSpawnPos`) |

### EventSpawnEntry.EventSpawnZone

Key: `zone`

Path: [`event`](#eventspawnsfileevent).`[]`.`zone`

Zone sets infected-count ranges and their spawn radius for positions in this
event. It is used when the event has a secondary infected event.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`EventSpawnZone`](#eventspawnzone) (`#/$defs/EventSpawnZone`) |

## EventSpawnPos

EventSpawnPos stores one mission-defined event position in map coordinates.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 5 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### EventSpawnPos.a

Key: `a`

Path: [`event`](#eventspawnsfileevent).`[]`.[`pos`](#eventspawnentrypos).`[]`.`a`

A is the event's yaw rotation in degrees. Shipped mission data also uses -1, so
retain the supplied value instead of normalizing it.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |

Key: `group`

Path: [`event`](#eventspawnsfileevent).`[]`.[`pos`](#eventspawnentrypos).`[]`.`group`

| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |

Key: `y`

Path: [`event`](#eventspawnsfileevent).`[]`.[`pos`](#eventspawnentrypos).`[]`.`y`
